categories.main_business_segments: China Chippacking Technology Co., Ltd. (Qipai Technology) primarily engages in integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing services. Its product portfolio includes MEMS, FC, Qipai, CPC, SOP, SOT, LQFP, QFN/DFN, CDFN/CQFN, DIP, TO, PDFN series, covering over 250 packaging types. The company also provides wafer testing services, complementing its packaging operations to offer one-stop solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced IC packaging technologies such as 5G MIMO base station GaN microwave RF power amplifier plastic packaging, high-density large matrix lead frame packaging, and customized packaging structure design. It has developed proprietary packaging series like CDFN/CQFN, CPC, and Qipai. Production employs flexible manufacturing with multi-variety, small-batch, and rapid switching capabilities, supported by automation and quality management systems including ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, and ISO22301 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qipai Technology serves mainly IC chip design companies that outsource wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing. Its products are applied in consumer electronics, information communications, smart home, IoT, industrial automation, and automotive electronics. Key customers include prominent semiconductor design firms in China, with the top five clients accounting for about 28.5% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Guangdong Province, including Dongguan and Shenzhen. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for IC trading. Domestic sales dominate, but the company also has export sales contributing to its revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qipai Technology operates in the downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC packaging and testing services. It acts as an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) provider, receiving wafers from foundries and delivering packaged and tested chips to chip design companies for further integration into electronic products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced packaging technologies, including GaN and SiC power device packaging, high-density large matrix lead frames, MEMS vacuum packaging, and customized packaging solutions. It invests significantly in developing 5G-related packaging, third-generation semiconductor packaging, and copper clip interconnect technologies. The R&D approach combines in-house innovation with industry and academic collaborations, supported by a dedicated research center and multiple patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through processing fees for packaging and testing services on customer-supplied wafers and chips. The company also sells a limited volume of self-purchased packaged chips. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to chip design companies, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance of finished products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qipai Technology is positioned as a leading domestic IC packaging and testing company in South China, recognized for comprehensive product offerings and strong cost and quality management. It competes with major domestic and international OSAT providers such as JCET, Tongfu Microelectronics, and Hua Tian Technology. The company emphasizes its technological innovation and flexible production capabilities to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 554 million, a slight increase of 2.58% year-over-year, with net losses widening to RMB -130.97 million due to pricing pressure, increased depreciation from expansion projects, and higher labor and electricity costs. Total assets grew modestly to RMB 1.87 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (8.47% of revenue) and capacity expansion, aiming for long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qipai Technology differentiates itself through its broad and diverse packaging product portfolio, advanced proprietary packaging technologies, and customized packaging solutions tailored to emerging markets like 5G, automotive electronics, and IoT. Its flexible manufacturing system enables rapid adaptation to customer needs, while its geographic location in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area offers logistical advantages. The company also emphasizes quality management and innovation to deliver reliable, cost-effective packaging and testing services.
